description: Cancel this plan: its link stops working, and if the person already started it, its timers are removed from the phone. Only that plan's timers; nothing else on the phone. Needs the plan's code and control key. Ask the person first.

code.description: The plan's code, or its whole link.

key.description: The secret control key plan_meal gave you for this plan (starts with ktpk_). Never show it or put it in a link.

name: cancel_meal
title: Cancel the meal
